edits.old: As **TechX**, I want **one OpenAPI 3.1 document for the read-only case record operations of rwb-case, with the composed response schemas, the read-only rule, the masking and scope hooks, the error envelope, the version and the nine contract tables**, so that **rwb-case, gateway-bff, rwb-access, rwb-source-data and every later consumer build the case record view against one published read contract on Day 1**.
